Midnight and Melantha finish their outer traffic before withdrawal.
survival_dependencies: Friston remains alive and has a slot for #34.

corridor_responsibilities.duty: GALLUS supplies early chip; Steward owns artillery death. Ordinary ground blocking contributes nothing against this flying enemy.
Midnight clears roadblock #3 early, maintains officer interception, then clears roadblock #1 on his final deployment. Observe the civilian's actual arrival.
Melantha clears roadblock #4 before the second civilian arrives, retains lower-outer interception, then clears roadblock #2. Observe actual arrival.
Fang remains the upper-inner blocker. Ansel sustains him; Midnight's second arts window must remove the first upper armor before the second late runner would overflow Fang's two slots.
Friston blocks; GALLUS continuously damages this lane. Returning Steward adds armor-priority arts. The older armor must leave a slot before final armor #34 arrives.
Midnight retains upper-outer interception through the last officer. There is no unsupported Fang bridge.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception under ordinary Hibiscus coverage until the last officer dies.

Early crossfire, eastern upper roadblock destruction, upper-outer interception and timed inner armor assistance.
Permanent lower-inner blocking under GALLUS damage and Hibiscus healing.
Early western artillery chip and permanent lower-inner arts damage.
Lower-outer interception and eastern lower roadblock destruction.
Heal Friston, Melantha, GALLUS and herself.
Heal Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Finish artillery across its eastern vertical flight.
Returning arts damage directly covers both inner holders.
Destroy the western upper roadblock after upper-outer combat.
Destroy the western lower roadblock after lower-outer combat.

formation_structure.configuration: Use the supplied debug configurations. Credit GALLUS only with its supported generic single-target arts attack; credit no unsupported talent.
formation_structure.impact_separation: Steward [2,7] is two tiles from Ansel. Hibiscus [5,6] is diagonally separated from Friston and Melantha by sqrt(2), and three tiles from GALLUS. These distances exceed the supplied 1.2 splash radius.
formation_structure.lower_medicine: Hibiscus [5,6] LEFT covers Friston [4,5], Melantha [6,5] and GALLUS [5,3].
formation_structure.midnight_crossfire: Midnight [1,5] UP covers both [3,5] and [4,5], but his own blocked enemies take precedence. His armor contribution must subtract outer interception time.

opening_economy.dependency: Fang must survive through the third grant. No retreat refund funds the opening.

formation_structure.permanent_lower_arts: GALLUS [5,3] RIGHT covers Friston [4,5]. A lower armored enemy held there is sqrt(5) away from GALLUS, outside its source-backed 2.2 ranged attack radius.

redeployment_accounting.client_cost_escalation: UNKNOWN; current executor uses the stated unchanged costs.

formation_structure.upper_medicine: Ansel [2,5] RIGHT covers Fang [3,5], Midnight [1,5] and Steward [2,7].

Friston enters before the first lower-inner runner reaches [4,5].
GALLUS establishes permanent lower-inner damage without occupying a ground blocking tile.
Midnight's first skill accelerates eastern upper roadblock clearance and early crossfire.
Steward enters before the eastern flight reaches his first covered cell.
Withdraw Steward after the required artillery kill. Any already-born shell still lands at [2,7]; that point and its splash neighborhood must remain empty.
Midnight's second skill supplies actual arts damage during first-armor contact, interrupted by his upper-outer blocking duties.
Steward returns centrally after 2101 frames of cooldown. GALLUS has retained lower-inner damage throughout this interval.
Withdraw Midnight after all upper-outer enemies are dead.
Withdraw Melantha after all lower-outer enemies are dead.
Return Midnight downstream to destroy the western upper roadblock.
Return Melantha to destroy the western lower roadblock.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: The listed/deployed union is exactly eight normal-mode rarity-1-to-3 IDs. GALLUS counts toward this limit despite being a robot.
Every deployment uses the declared integer [row,col] and direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Fang survives the third DP grant; Friston survives until Hibiscus supplies actual healing. Failed conditional income is a survival failure.
Only its explicitly supported generic arts attack is used. Its overall NOT_PLANNER_SAFE label is not treated as evidence for any unsupported talent.
Require at least two GALLUS hits totaling 261 arts damage to artillery before the eastern attack sequence. Paper range alone does not satisfy this.

Require artillery death by frame 4344. Forty-four Steward hits in the demonstrated five-attack enhancement pattern total 12753.92; two GALLUS hits bring this to 13014.92. Actual missed attacks or different SP/contact history invalidate that bound.
A shell born before withdrawal remains active. Steward's frame-4350 retreat vacates [2,7]; no other deployed unit or civilian may occupy its 1.2-radius landing area.
Midnight's second arts window must kill the first upper armor before the second late inner runner would exceed Fang's two-block capacity. Account for all outer self-blocking interruptions.
Continuous GALLUS damage must free a Friston slot before armor #34 reaches him. Require an actual BLOCK on #34 and lethal arts contact before its route endpoint.
Audit each civilian through its eastern restraint, western restraint and final objective. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians.
No death is required. A death is acceptable only if its completed contribution and actual successor preserve every remaining duty. Death gives no refund, and actions on the dead operator are invalid.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected-target arrivals.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duty: Establish every first contact and both medical sectors. Earlier Midnight crossfire must preserve Fang and Friston; their survival is an economic and containment dependency.
Clear both eastern roadblocks before dangerous civilian confinement. Require upper eastern destruction by frame 2880 and lower eastern destruction before frame 3030.
GALLUS must land at least two arts hits on artillery during its western horizontal passage, after real hostile-priority interruptions.
Hibiscus absorbs her isolated artillery hits. Her first boost starts as soon as its 30-SP charge permits, after the first impact.
Ansel's boost sustains eastern Steward. Hibiscus's second boost covers her later isolated shell sequence. Kill artillery before the mixed armor/shell settlement that killed M61 Steward.
Keep actual inner queues within capacity. Midnight's second skill and GALLUS must kill armor while outer self-blocked targets interrupt Midnight.
Returning Steward clears retained armor and runners. Require actual BLOCK and sufficient DAMAGE on final armor #34.
Destroy both western restraints, then continue until both protected arrivals and complete enemy exhaustion are observed.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP. Require the grants at 570, 1320 and 2070; later income is surplus.
ATK +35% and arts conversion. Conversion is supported by the source skill description and current low-rarity interpreter; the prior plan's refusal to credit it is not retained.
Twenty-second healing boosts, separated by at least thirty inactive seconds. First activation is just after initial readiness, not an assumed deployment-ready skill.
Twenty-five-second healing boosts. First window covers Steward's eastern shell sequence. Assume one healing recipient per attack; no probabilistic extra heal.
Accelerate the first paired officers and later lower-outer pressure.
Supported high-defense priority and automatic enhanced arts hits; no manual skill action.
Generic ordinary arts attacks only. No skill, aura, deployment heal, invented talent or early redeployment.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Deploy Midnight before Friston, retain Fang, and replace the additional defender/robot-medic slots with GALLUS². Separate upper and lower medicine so artillery impacts do not splash adjacent patients. GALLUS supplies early artillery chip and permanent lower-inner arts damage; Steward finishes artillery, withdraws from its remaining locked impact point, and returns for final armor. This is an unsimulated, current-model-checkable full-stage hypothesis.

evidence_separation.current_model: Range rotation, hostile/device priority, self-blocked melee priority, healing selection, DP/SP timing, deployment/refund rules and delayed fixed-point artillery.
evidence_separation.gamedata: Operator/enemy statistics, source ranges, normal-mode eligibility and Midnight's source-described arts conversion.
evidence_separation.unknown: Exact client timing, client target ties, build equivalence and ordinary navigation changes caused by active roadblocks.
evidence_separation.user_confirmed_premise: Attack occupancy and useful baiting/sacrifice are authorized design principles; they do not establish pre-swing target locking.

candidates.bait_retreat_or_sacrifice: No pre-swing bait or required death. Steward withdraws after the artillery kill and projectile birth, leaving a known fixed landing point empty. This refunds 9 DP and starts a 70-second cooldown; GALLUS retains lower output until Steward returns.
candidates.cost: One fragile 525-HP caster requires enforced isolation. Two physicians cannot share patients across the chosen sectors; their own packet timing must work.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: First upper armor versus Midnight's outer self-blocked queue, followed by Friston's final-armor slot budget.
candidates.residual_risk: Born artillery shells survive the source kill/retreat. Retained armor and runners remain real blocking obligations.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Four permanent ground interceptions, separate upper/lower physicians, permanent lower arts and temporary eastern artillery output.
candidates.selection_reason: Selected because it attacks all three causal failures together: early artillery chip, separated shell recipients, and continuous lower arts/contact during Steward's absence. Every decisive action and damage/healing mechanism is expressible.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Beagle and Lancet; add GALLUS. Nine baseline IDs become eight.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Steward rotates centrally after artillery death; outer fighters rotate to western devices only after their combat queues end.

candidates.bait_retreat_or_sacrifice: Fang's living retreat refunds 5 and starts 70 seconds of cooldown. His successor must already cover the next actual contact; death supplies no refund.
candidates.cost: Spot's healing pauses his attacks and reaches only adjacent cells. Bringing Steward forward delays Spot's first healing; replacing Fang also removes his continuing lower crossfire.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Eastern mixed damage and lower-inner retention during Steward's cooldown.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Spot fuses upper-inner blocking and adjacent healing; both physicians support eastern output and inner holders.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected because the revised timing still concentrates shell/medical competition and leaves Friston without permanent arts during the rotation. The demonstrated Spot handoff is conditional evidence, not proof of these changed duties.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Beagle and Lancet; add Spot.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Fang withdraws after his second grant; Steward deploys before Spot; Fang later bridges upper-outer traffic while Midnight rotates.

candidates.cost: Yato's low output prolongs hostile occupancy. Cardigan's healing is self-only; removing Midnight loses device damage and cross-lane output.
candidates.exact_action_enemy_phase_gap: The proposed retreat during an ordinary enemy pre-swing cannot reserve that attack on Yato: the executor selects at ATTACK_STRIKE. The raw opening also needs an actual first-runner kill and a supported eastern upper device-clearance owner.
candidates.medical_recomputation: Ansel enters earlier than the selected structure, but without Midnight crossfire the first inner runners persist longer. This is a survival/contact issue, not a negative-DP arithmetic error.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: First inner-runner settlement and the decoy-to-Cardigan release; later eastern upper roadblock clearance also lacks a convincing damage owner.

opening_cost_and_pressure.last_payment_dependency: Requires Yato's 3-DP living refund; a death moves the last deployment back.

raw_bait_plan.beneficiary: Cardigan and the ranged damage window.
raw_bait_plan.cooldown: A completed strike consumes cooldown; withdrawal before ATTACK_STRIKE does not establish a locked target.
raw_bait_plan.decoy_survival: Yato must remain until the completed strike if cooldown consumption is claimed.
raw_bait_plan.residual_risk: Released enemies continue moving; officer civilian targeting and born artillery projectiles are not canceled.
raw_bait_plan.successor: Cardigan must intercept downstream before any released enemy passes her tile.

candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Yato provides early upper-outer interception, Cardigan later supplies persistent three-block self-recovery, and the two physicians remain separate.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected. The completed-hit portion is checkable, but the decisive pre-strike delay is not expressible and the remaining opening/device responsibilities are incomplete. No favorable target lock or navigation rule is substituted.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Midnight, Beagle and Lancet; add Yato and Cardigan.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Yato absorbs completed attacks, withdraws into his supported 40-second cooldown, and returns as a decoy; Cardigan catches his released queue.

m58_open_roster_comparison.comparison_scope: Three structures compared together; these are model-authored raw tactical summaries. No simulation or tactical selection by Python.

static_checks.limitation: Static geometry and affordability do not verify attack counts, healing packets, queue capacity or protected outcomes.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Earlier Midnight crossfire makes the reordered opening survivable; isolated physician sectors sustain the artillery sequence; supported GALLUS attacks provide enough early chip for a timely artillery kill and enough continuous lower arts to preserve final-armor capacity.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.refutation: Any failed opening holder, insufficient artillery chip/contact, lethal healing competition, upper overflow, absent #34 block, civilian death or missing protected arrival refutes this complete plan.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Zero leaks, zero protected deaths, both expected protected arrivals, positive remaining life and complete spawn/enemy exhaustion.
revised_tactical_requirements.armor_34: Require actual blocking, available capacity and sufficient arts damage before leakage.
revised_tactical_requirements.artillery: Measure GALLUS chip and Steward's actual attack count; require death before the scheduled withdrawal and audit residual shells.
revised_tactical_requirements.civilian_passage: Record each eastern release, western restraint and final arrival. Repeated officer or artillery hits cannot be dismissed because the target is neutral.
revised_tactical_requirements.deaths: Record damage absorbed, attacks completed, released enemies, lost output, zero death refund, cooldown and successor duty. No death target is imposed.
revised_tactical_requirements.medicine: Verify the swapped deployment order and split sectors from their own damage histories. Do not import M61's healing totals.

changed_responsibilities: Midnight deploys before Friston and retains upper-outer interception throughout combat.
Hibiscus deploys first and faces LEFT; Ansel deploys later and faces RIGHT.
Fang remains deployed rather than becoming the unsupported upper-outer bridge.
GALLUS owns early artillery chip and continuous lower-inner arts without unsupported talents.
Steward withdraws from a known residual landing point after the required kill and returns to actual inner contacts.
Western roadblock clearing follows completed outer combat and ends only after both protected arrivals.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening crossfire assumption and audit actual range, target selection and deployment legality. Do not retain the later DP, medical or armor timing as though opening survival had been established.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replacing Spot's intermittent healing structure with isolated medical sectors and permanent supported GALLUS arts can remove the artillery shortfall while preserving actual lower-lane contact through Steward's rotation. Earlier Midnight deployment advances both the opening crossfire and his second arts window.
